title: BBC Club · the database
description: Production's Postgres from its own statistics, read as bbc_monitor (pg_monitor): the slowest statements, the indexes never read, dead rows, HOT updates, sizes, temporary files (ADR-IMPL-077).

panels.title: Slowest statements, by total time
panels.description: The 20 statements that took the most of the database's time since the last reset: execution and planning, calls, plans (a prepared statement plans once), rows (ADR-IMPL-074, -077).

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 160) AS query, calls, plans, round(total_exec_time::numeric, 1) AS exec_ms, round(total_plan_time::numeric, 1) AS plan_ms, round((total_exec_time / greatest(calls, 1))::numeric, 3) AS ms_per_call, rows FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) ORDER BY total_exec_time + total_plan_time DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Indexes never read
panels.description: Secondary indexes no statement has read since statistics began: what each costs at every write, for nothing. A candidate to drop only after two weeks of real members (⚑E, ADR-IMPL-077).

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.schemaname || '.' || i.relname AS table_name, i.indexrelname AS index_name, i.idx_scan, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid)) AS size FROM pg_stat_user_indexes i JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = i.indexrelid WHERE NOT x.indisprimary AND NOT x.indisunique AND i.idx_scan = 0 ORDER BY pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid) DESC, 1, 2

panels.title: Dead rows
panels.description: Rows deleted or replaced that vacuum has not reclaimed yet, by table, and when autovacuum last ran: the queues should stay under a few percent (0050, 0051).

targets.rawSql: SELECT schemaname || '.' || relname AS table_name, n_live_tup AS live, n_dead_tup AS dead, round(100.0 * n_dead_tup / greatest(n_live_tup + n_dead_tup, 1), 1) AS dead_pct, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Updates that stayed on their page (HOT)
panels.description: Of each table's updates, the share that wrote no index (HOT): an update that changes an indexed column never is. Where it is low on a table whose updates change no indexed column, a fillfactor below 100 helps (ADR-IMPL-077).

targets.rawSql: SELECT schemaname || '.' || relname AS table_name, n_tup_upd AS updates, n_tup_hot_upd AS hot, round(100.0 * n_tup_hot_upd / greatest(n_tup_upd, 1), 1) AS hot_pct FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE n_tup_upd > 0 ORDER BY n_tup_upd DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Largest tables
panels.description: Each table's size on disk: the table, its indexes and the two together. The retention jobs keep the queues and the logs from growing (ADR-IMPL-077).

targets.rawSql: SELECT schemaname || '.' || relname AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(relid)) AS heap, pg_size_pretty(pg_indexes_size(relid)) AS indexes FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Statements that spill to disk
panels.description: Statements whose sorts or hashes did not fit work_mem (8 MB) and wrote temporary files: a query to fix, rarely a setting to raise (ADR-IMPL-077).

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 160) AS query, calls, pg_size_pretty(temp_blks_written * 8192) AS temp_written, round((total_exec_time / greatest(calls, 1))::numeric, 3) AS ms_per_call FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE dbid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) AND temp_blks_written > 0 ORDER BY temp_blks_written DESC LIMIT 20
